title: FO reiterates Pakistan's 'firm and unshakeable' commitment to Saudi Arabia's security after Riyadh attack

article.title: FO reiterates Pakistan's 'firm and unshakeable' commitment to Saudi Arabia's security after Riyadh attack
article.summary: The Foreign Office (FO) on Sunday condemned a fresh wave of Houthi attacks against Saudi Arabia, reaffirming Pakistan’s “firm and unshakeable” commitment to the sovereignty, territorial integrity, security and stability of the Gulf state under the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement. The defence pact , of which Turkiye is also a part, was signed on August 7 and aims to strengthen collective deterrence and empower its signatory states to treat an attack against one of them as an attack against all of them. The statement comes following Saturday’s attack on Riyadh’s international airport, which killed at least 12 people and wounded 309 others. In a post on X, FO said the targeting of a civilian airport constituted “a heinous act of terrorism, a flagrant violation of international law and a grave threat to regional peace and security”.
